sheet.scheduleNotes: Final results. Optimist C uses 57 numbered heats. Each sailor has 9 scored heats. R1–R9 are that sailor’s chronological heat starts, not shared fleet races; each raw score retains its official heat number. Published tied ranks retained. No sail numbers or genders are printed in this sheet.
